svg.text: Interfaces between subsystems (count; see N2 view)

Generated by tools/figures/results_readme.py from the committed results, the code that writes and reads them and the CI workflows. Synthetic: no result here is verification evidence (sim/README.md, evidence gate).

g.text: Terms: BMS = battery management system · CI = continuous integration (the automated checks GitHub runs on every change) · ESC = electronic speed controller (drives a UAV motor) · HAZ-nnn = hazard record (safety/hazards/HAZ-xxx-nnn.yaml) · IF = interface (a count of interfaces

in block diagrams, or an IF-nnn record) · IF-nnn = interface in the item definition (architecture/item-definition.yaml) · IF-PX4-nnn = PX4 integration interface (integrations/px4/interface-contract.md) · PX4 = PX4 Autopilot, the open-source flight-control software candidate

for SUS-A1 · SUS-A1 = dockable observation UAV · SUS-A1-FC = PX4-based flight controller · SUS-A1-NAV = navigation sensors, camera and telemetry · SUS-A1-PROP = motors, ESCs and propellers · SUS-A1-PWR = UAV battery and power management · SUS-GSE = ground support, maintenance

supports, charging and test equipment · SUS-I1 = integrated mechanized walker and observation UAV · SUS-I1-INT = integration manager and PX4 command adapter · SUS-M1 = piloted walker · SUS-M1-CTL = mission, motion and balance control · SUS-M1-DCK = UAV dock, retention,

charging and release · SUS-M1-MAN = manipulation arms and end effectors · SUS-M1-PIL = pilot station, restraints, displays and controls · SUS-M1-PWR = power generation, storage, distribution and thermal control · SUS-M1-PWR-BAT = battery pack, BMS and contactors (alternative

B) · SUS-M1-PWR-DIST = protected power distribution · SUS-M1-PWR-GEN = engine-generator and governor (alternative B) · SUS-M1-PWR-HPU = hydraulic power unit, accumulators and isolation (alternative A) · SUS-M1-SAF = independent safety monitor, protective stop and isolation ·
SUS-M1-WLK = chassis, legs, joint actuators and stability sensing · UAV = uncrewed aerial vehicle (drone)
